messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a staged rollout of the autoscale policy (autoscale-policy v3) to the dedicated reserved pool `gpu-prod-reserved` tomorrow 09:30 PT. Morgan will execute. Staging across 3 shards, 10m gaps between shards. Need quick smoke checks and rollback readiness. Posting checklist below.

morgan: I can take the deploy. Timeline + ownership acked. Will follow the checklist and post status after each shard.

pat: Oncall coverage? Who's watching infra metrics during the window?

riley: I'll be oncall 09:00-11:00 PT and will monitor. Alerts to watch: `GPUUtil > 85% for 5m`, `QueueDepth > 50 for 2m`, `error-rate > 3%`. Ping me in-channel and DM if anything funny.

qa-arnold: Smoke script is ready: `./scripts/smoke/smoke-gpu.sh --pool gpu-prod-reserved --samples 50`. Smoke expectations: KV cache hit >= 0.6, p50 latency < 120ms, error-rate < 1%. If smoke fails, do not proceed to next shard.

alex: Deploy steps (simple):
```
# canary shard 1
kubectl apply -f autoscale-policy-v3-canary-1.yaml --context=prod
./scripts/smoke/smoke-gpu.sh --pool gpu-prod-reserved --shard canary-1
# wait 10m, verify metrics
# if OK, apply canary-2, repeat
```
Rollback commands (quick):
```
# roll back to previous policy
kubectl rollout undo deployment/autoscaler -n inference --to-revision="autoscale-policy-v2"
# or apply last known-good manifest
kubectl apply -f autoscale-policy-v2.yaml --context=prod
```

morgan: Note: autoscale-policy v3 includes a shorter cooldown (30s) and changes to scale-down thresholds. I've verified these in staging. Will include a guard that prevents full roll to all shards if shard smoke fails.

devops-bot: Reminder: new policy enables burst-buckets feature flag. If you need to opt out, set `feature.burst_buckets=false` in the config before apply.

pat: Approving the plan. I'll be available to trigger rollback if error-rate > 3% or p95 latency > 2x baseline. Also please post a one-line status after each shard (success/fail + wall time).

morgan: Roger. I'll post messages like: `shard-1: started 09:30 PT -> smoke OK (KV=0.72, p50=98ms)`, etc. If rollback happens I will include exact kubectl command run and revision.

alex: Small coordination items:
- Keep traffic routing unchanged (no blue/green). We rely on autoscaler semantics only.
- Do not change quantization/instance types during this window.
- If anything, escalate to #eng-oncall and tag @riley.

riley: I'll run a quick preflight script 30m before deploy to capture baseline metrics and synthetic load results. Paste here when done.

morgan: Thanks. I'll kick off canary-1 at 09:30 PT tomorrow. Posting timestamps as I go. :thumbsup:

alex: Perfect. Thanks everyone — see you in the channel during the window.
